verses.translation: A Song of Degrees. Unto thee who dwellest in heaven have I lifted up mine eyes.

translations.ron: Către Tine, Cel ce locuieşti în cer, am ridicat ochii mei.
translations.grk: Ὠδὴ τῶν ἀναβαθμῶν. Πρὸς σὲ ᾖρα τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου, τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ.

verses.translation: Behold, as the eyes of servants are directed to the hands of their masters, and as the eyes of a maid-servant to the hands of her mistress; so our eyes are directed to the Lord our God, until he have mercy upon us.

translations.ron: Iată, precum sunt ochii robilor la mâinile stăpânilor lor, precum sunt ochii slujnicei la mâinile stăpânei sale, aşa sunt ochii noştri către Domnul Dumnezeul nostru, până ce Se va milostivi spre noi.
translations.grk: Ἰδοὺ ὡς ὀφθαλμοὶ δούλων εἰς χεῖρας τῶν κυρίων αὐτῶν, ὡς ὀφθαλμοὶ παιδίσκης εἰς χεῖρας τῆς κυρίας αὐτῆς, οὕτως οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν πρὸς Κύριον τὸν Θεὸν ἡμῶν, ἕως οὗ οἰκτειρῆσαι ἡμᾶς.

verses.translation: Have pity upon us, O Lord, have pity upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

translations.ron: Miluieşte-ne pe noi, Doamne, miluieşte-ne pe noi, că mult ne-am săturat de defăimare,
translations.grk: Ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς Κύριε, ἐλέησον ἡμᾶς, ὅτι ἐπὶ πολὺ ἐπλήσθημεν ἐξουδενώσεως.

verses.translation: Yea, our soul has been exceedingly filled with it: let the reproach be to them that are at ease, and contempt to the proud.

translations.ron: Că prea mult s-a săturat sufletul nostru de ocara celor îndestulaţi şi de defăimarea celor mândri.
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ πλεῖον ἐπλήσθη ἡ ψυχὴ ἡμῶν· τὸ ὄνειδος τοῖς εὐθηνοῦσι καὶ ἡ ἐξουδένωσις τοῖς ὑπερηφάνοις.
